hash_user_username: hash a username with a random salt using SHA-256 and return the salted hash
check_username_validation: check if a plaintext username matches a previously hashed username with salt
number_from_span_parse: parse a string into a number, supporting both numeric and word-based input like 'three'
manhat_dist_3d: compute the Manhattan distance between two 3D coordinate tuples
get_bounds_min_max: compute the min and max bounds along each axis from a numpy array of locations
